summary: Perform Error message ToString before consulting the options cause property.

order: ToString(message) if message is not undefined
HasProperty/Get cause if options is Object
semantics.abrupt: message conversion failure prevents cause lookup

tests.name: message before cause
tests.input: let s=[]; const m={toString(){s.push('m');return 'x'}}; const o={get cause(){s.push('c');return 1}}; Error(m,o); console.log(s.join(','))

tests.name: message throw skips cause
tests.input: let hit=false; const m={toString(){throw 1}}; const o={get cause(){hit=true}}; try{Error(m,o)}catch(e){} console.log(hit)
